Where are the best New Year's Eve fireworks on Koh Samui? | Chaweng has the biggest fireworks and the biggest party, with displays along the whole bay and a free countdown at Central Samui. Next come Fisherman's Village in Bophut, Lamai, Maenam and Choeng Mon. Maenam and Choeng Mon are the calmest and most family-friendly places to watch at midnight on 31 December 2026.
Is there a free New Year's Eve countdown party on Samui? | Yes. Central Samui, the mall opposite Chaweng Lake, held a free public countdown on NYE 2025 with concerts, cultural shows and midnight fireworks, and the same format is expected for 2026. ARKbar on Chaweng Beach was free before 21:00 and 500 THB after on NYE 2025. Fireworks on public beaches are free to watch.
Is there a Full Moon Party on Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve? | Yes, both in 2026. The full moon falls on Thursday 24 December, so the Full Moon Party is on Christmas Eve, and Haad Rin holds its New Year countdown party on Thursday 31 December. Entry is about 200 THB in cash at the beach. These are the two busiest party nights of the year.
How do I get to the NYE Full Moon Party from Samui? | Book a return boat with hotel pickup, because public ferries don't run back to Samui in the middle of the night. We sell shared and private Full Moon speedboats from Samui for 31 December; check the booking page for the NYE seat price, and book by early December. The public Haad Rin Queen leaves Big Buddha pier in the daytime only.
When should I book NYE dinners and boats on Koh Samui? | Book by early December at the latest. Popular NYE parties, galas and set dinners sell out by mid-December, Full Moon boats for 24 and 31 December fill early, and Bangkok Airways flights were full after NYE 2025. Book villas several months ahead and check for compulsory gala supplements.
Is Ang Thong Marine Park open over Christmas? | Yes. Ang Thong National Marine Park is closed every year from 1 November to 15 December and reopens on 16 December, so it is open over Christmas and New Year. Our Ang Thong speedboat tour costs 1,800 THB adult and 1,400 THB child in 2026. The park fee is paid in cash at the park.
Can we watch the New Year fireworks from a boat on Samui? | Sometimes, depending on availability, the sea state in late December and safe night navigation. Private charters on 31 December book up early and are priced individually, so message us on WhatsApp with your group size and we will tell you honestly what is possible. A daytime private boat on 31 December or 1 January is easier to arrange.
Will it rain at Christmas on Koh Samui? | Possibly. December averages about 263 mm of rain over 12 days, much less than November's 445 mm, and the second half of the month is usually drier. Expect short showers rather than all-day rain, highs of about 29 °C and sea temperatures around 28 °C. January is drier still, at about 127 mm.
